Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: Which of the following manufactured products can be produced using petroleum as a raw material?
A. plastic soda bottles
B. aluminum cans
C. porcelain cups
D. copper pot
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
